title: Klebelsberg Kuno és a kultúrfölény (Education Reform & Nobel Prize)
grammar: Institutional Participles (-andó/-endő), Instrumentality Connectors & Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can understand and discuss Education Reform & Nobel Prize in interwar Hungarian history.
I can give the aim of an action with azzal a céllal, hogy and annak érdekében, hogy.
I can say what Klebelsberg did for schools and universities.
I can use six words about the education reforms, such as kultúrfölény and népiskola.
